name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) requires the box pickup, and the three hard Precedence clauses require it to follow an open door and require the blocker and key before the door. The two door prerequisites may occur in either order, as the task specifies.

texts: Pick up the box after the door is open.
Open the door after moving the blocking ball and acquiring the key, in either order.
Open the door after moving the blocking ball and acquiring the key, in either order.
Pick up the box in the other room.
